title: First Russian Diesel Under US Waiver Sails Toward New York
dek: The first Russian fuel cargo bound for the US since the 2022 ban is due around 7 November.
body: Agioi Fanendes loaded about 40,000 t at Primorsk on 22 October. It now signals “for orders,” with no confirmed port.

panels.label: Washington and Moscow Say
panels.text: Trump says the deal brings “massive amounts of oil”; Peskov says shipments will continue “on a regular basis.”

panels.label: Kyiv and Sanctions Hawks Say
panels.text: Zelensky says the waiver is a “reward” for Putin; 12 senators say it is “a gift to our adversary.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side says the deal lowers fuel prices, the other that it funds the war; at stake is who pays for sanctions.
